text: During World War Two, the Polish Army officially enlisted a five hundred pound brown bear.
asr: During World War II, the Polish Army officially enlisted a 500-pound brown bear.

text: After adopting an orphaned cub named Voytek in Iran, soldiers taught him to salute, wrestle, and drink beer.
asr: After adopting an orphaned cub named Voitek in Iran, soldiers taught him to salute, wrestle, and drink beer.

text: When British port officials banned pets from boarding their warship to Italy, the soldiers drafted Voytek as a real private with his own paybook.
asr: When British port officials banned pets from boarding their warship to Italy, the soldiers drafted Voitek as a real private with his own paybook.

text: Then at Monte Cassino, while cannons roared, Voytek watched the exhausted crew and began hauling heavy ammo crates himself.
asr: Then at Monte Cassino while cannons roared, Vojtek watched the exhausted crew and began hauling heavy ammo crates himself.

text: He never dropped a single shell, earning promotion to Corporal and a place on the company's official emblem.
